_note: v2 hook overrides for the église. Each painting shows exactly what its hook says. v1 data is untouched.

fr_nef_noun.hook: Like "nave", said NEHF: the long NAVE lined with pews is the 'ship' of the church — a model ship hangs overhead, its deck full of tiny pews.
fr_nef_noun.why: v1 hook (nave lined with pews) did not explain the painted model ship. Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_cortege_noun.hook: Like English "cortège", said kor-TEHZH: a slow, solemn CORTÈGE — the bride, the groom and a little page boy holding the train walk up the aisle together.
fr_cortege_noun.why: v1 hook is a funeral; replaced with a gentle, age-appropriate wedding cortège, as painted. Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_banc_noun.hook: Like "bench", said BAHN: a long wooden PEW (BAHN) with a hot-cross BUN left on its seat.
fr_banc_noun.why: « le banc » here is a church pew; v1 hook is a piggy bank and the source hook is a park bench with a piece of candy.

fr_basilique_noun.hook: Like "basilica", said bah-zee-LEEK: a grand domed BASILICA rises on the hill beside a giant pot of BASIL.
fr_basilique_noun.why: v1 hook puts the model on a hall shelf; the parvis painting shows it on the hillside.

fr_clochette_noun.hook: La cloche (the bell) + -ette (little), said kloh-SHEHT: the church cat's collar carries a SMALL BELL that tinkles as it sits on the square.
fr_clochette_noun.why: Painted as the cat's collar bell, outdoors on the parvis (v1: at the altar). Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_arcade_noun.hook: Like "arcade", said ahr-KAHD: three pigeons shelter under the stone ARCADE, its arches marching along the square.
fr_arcade_noun.why: The parvis is sunny; rain removed.

fr_eglise_noun.hook: "Eh, GLEE!" ("ay-GLEEZ"): a GLEEful painted Easter egg with a little CHURCH on it sits on the church steps.
fr_eglise_noun.why: The church is painted on the gleeful egg; no sign needed.

fr_chapelle_noun.hook: Close to "chapel", said shah-PEHL: a little stone CHAPEL perched on the hillside above the square.
fr_chapelle_noun.why: Painted on the hill, not in the square.

fr_paroissien_noun.hook: Like "parishioner", said pah-rwah-SYAN: an old PARISHIONER arranges sunflowers in a vase by the pews.
fr_paroissien_noun.why: No font is painted beside him.

fr_vitrail_noun.hook: "vee-TRAHY" ≈ "V-TRAIN": a tall STAINED-GLASS WINDOW glowing red, blue and gold, its glass picture showing a little steam TRAIN.
fr_vitrail_noun.why: Matches the painted window. Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_chemin_de_croix_noun.hook: Word for word "the way of the cross", said shuh-man-duh-KRWAH: a framed STATION OF THE CROSS — a little path (chemin) winds up the hill to a cross (croix).
fr_chemin_de_croix_noun.why: One framed station is painted, not fourteen. Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_transept_noun.hook: Like "transept", said trahn-SEHPT: a little model church shows its TRANSEPT, the two side arms that make the cross shape.
fr_transept_noun.why: Painted as the cross-shaped model church.

fr_encens_noun.hook: Like "incense", said ahn-SAHN: a little brass box of INCENSE grains waits beside the candles.
fr_encens_noun.why: The incense box, not the smoke, carries the hotspot.

fr_sacristie_noun.hook: Like "sacristy", said sah-krees-TEE: a framed picture of the quiet SACRISTY, vestments hanging inside.
fr_sacristie_noun.why: The hotspot is the framed sacristy picture.

fr_etole_noun.hook: Like "stole", said ay-TOL: an embroidered purple STOLE hangs from a hook on the armoire door.
fr_etole_noun.why: No priest is painted (and none is needed).

fr_dalmatique_noun.hook: Like "dalmatic", said dahl-mah-TEEK: a deacon's DALMATIC with wide sleeves — and a spotty DALMATIAN naps beneath it.

fr_burette_noun.hook: Like "burette" (a lab glass tube), said bew-REHT: two little glass CRUETS of water on a tray.
fr_burette_noun.why: Cognate shown as the glass cruets; no wine mentioned.

fr_chandelle_noun.hook: "shahn-DEHL": in the window niche hangs a tiny CHANDELIER, a ring of CANDLES — une chandelle is one of them (the dancing candle beside it is la bougie).
fr_chandelle_noun.why: Chandler is the English candle word; the candle is painted on the sill.

fr_quete_noun.hook: "KEHT" ≈ QUEST without the S: a little knight on a QUEST, map in hand, passes the church COLLECTION plate.
fr_quete_noun.why: Knight now carries a quest map instead of a sword (no weapons). Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_aube_noun.en: alb (the long white vestment); also: dawn
fr_aube_noun.hook: "OHB": the priest's long white ALB is a ROBE that lost its R.
fr_aube_noun.why: RECS 1.4/2.2: sacristy = the vestment; the dawn rooster was painted out.

fr_chaire_noun.hook: "SHEHR" ≈ CHAIR: a carved wooden PULPIT high above the nave, the priest's tall CHAIR to preach from.
fr_chaire_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_fidele_noun.hook: Like FIDELITY (faithfulness), said fee-DEHL: the FAITHFUL BELIEVERS kneel in the pews.
fr_fidele_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_prie_dieu_noun.hook: Word for word "pray-God" (prie, as in prier), said pree-DYEUH: a padded KNEELER in front of a pew.
fr_prie_dieu_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_clocher_noun.hook: La cloche (the bell) gives le clocher, said kloh-SHAY: a BELL TOWER rings its big cloche over the village square.
fr_clocher_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_benitier_noun.hook: Like BENEDICTION (a blessing), said bay-nee-TYAY: a HOLY-WATER STOUP of stone by the church door.
fr_benitier_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_portail_noun.hook: Like English "portal", said por-TAHY: a carved stone CHURCH DOORWAY opens onto the square.
fr_portail_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_enfant_de_choeur_noun.hook: Word for word "child of the choir", said ahn-fahn-duh-KUHR: an ALTAR SERVER carries a candle in the sacristy.
fr_enfant_de_choeur_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).

fr_encensoir_noun.hook: L'encens (incense) gives l'encensoir, said ahn-sahn-SWAHR: a swinging brass CENSER trails sweet smoke.
fr_encensoir_noun.why: Text pass 2026-10-28: reworded without etymology or the 'Linked to' template (same painted content).
